extras.real_size: 1950s station wagon, approx. 5.4 x 2.0 x 1.65 m (L x W x H), wheel diameter 0.72 m
extras.notes: front faces -Y; generic, brand-free 1950s family station wagon: sky blue body, cream roof skin and side band, chrome roof rails, wraparound windshield, small tail fins with round tail lights, twin round headlights, chrome bumpers with guards, whitewall tyres; 4 wheels are separate objects with origin on the hub (rotate around local X to roll); hollow cabin with transparent windows, two bench seats, cargo floor and steering wheel; blank number plates, no brand, no logo, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
